question: Which of the following is the earliest form of Veda?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 4**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Vedas** are considered to be the **oldest literature** of the **Indian subcontinent**.
 
• There are **four Vedas**. Among these,** Rigveda** is the **oldest **and first to be composed.
 
• **Rigveda** consists of** ten mandalas or books** and **1028 hymns**.
 
• The** hymns** were sung in the praises of** Agni, Indra, Mitra, Varuna,** and other Gods. 
 
• **Lord Indra** is the chief deity cited in the **Rig Veda**.
 
• The famous** Gayatri mantra (Savitri)** is in **Rig-Veda**.
 
• **The** **Varna System**, **Four-fold division of society**, **‘Sudra**’, and **Purusha Shukta Hymns** are also mentioned in **Rig Veda**.
